```{r}
df = read.csv("../data/forecast_dataset.csv")
```

```{r}
val_start  <- which(dates >= as.Date("2021-01-01"))[1]
test_start <- which(dates >= as.Date("2023-01-01"))[1]
```

```{r historical average}
n <- length(df$close_usd_per_troy_oz)

ha_exp <- sapply(test_start:n, function(t) mean(r[1:(t-1)]))          # expanding
ha_rol <- sapply(test_start:n, function(t) mean(r[(t-500):(t-1)]))    # 500-day rolling
y <- df[test_start:n]
mse <- function(f) mean((y - f)^2)

r2_oos_vs_ha   <- function(f) 1 - mse(f) / mse(ha_exp)
r2_oos_vs_zero <- function(f) 1 - mse(f) / mean(y^2)
```
